segments.name: Crude oil and natural gas development, exploration, and production
segments.description: Acquires, explores, develops and produces crude oil and natural gas properties in the United States, primarily in the Permian Basin of West Texas and Southeastern New Mexico.
segments.evidence: Accordingly, the Company has one reportable segment: crude oil and natural gas development, exploration, and production.

revenueModel.text: The company earns revenue from selling crude oil and natural gas production to various purchasers, plus income from investments in LLCs holding royalty interests.
revenueModel.evidence: Our primary credit risk is related to oil and gas production sold to various purchasers and the receivables are generally not collateralized.
